# TTyPack Manual

This manual explains how the two bundles fit together and how to select the
smallest useful layer for an application. The API reference generated from
the headers is complementary: the manual explains concepts and workflows,
while the reference documents declarations and signatures.

## Chapters

1. \ref manual_getting_started
2. \ref manual_architecture
3. \ref manual_terminal
4. \ref manual_emulation
5. \ref manual_os
6. \ref manual_text
7. \ref manual_ui
8. \ref manual_integration
9. \ref manual_contributing
10. \ref manual_api_map

All examples use C++20 and assume the include directory is available with
`-Iinclude`.
